text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess hasn't shown up for
training,
so I ask around before heading
out to look for
her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Look at these beefed up aesthetics! I
can see why
King had such high praise
for this art
exhibition! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ With this, I'm another step
closer to
becoming the noblest of ladies,
just like her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, clearly! King would never do
something so
stup—
choice_data_list: キングはきっと練習を忘れないぞ？
キングはきっと練習を忘れないよ？
choice_data_list_en: King definitely wouldn't forget to practice, right?
King definitely wouldn't forget to practice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer? What're you doing here?
And
what's that about prac...tice?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ack! I-I-I had practice today, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! It completely slipped my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess seems truly
remorseful about
her mistake. I warn her
that while
self-improvement is all well
and good, training
should be her top
priority.
